newsitem.title: USA: Studies give Bristol-Myers drug boost - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Studies give Bristol-Myers drug boost - WSJ.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co could see sales of its drug Pravachol rise following new scientific studies showing that it helps maintain blood flow to the heart, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
Citing industry analysts, the newspaper said the conclusions of the studies could help the drug that fights cholesterol take away market share from competing drugs.

It also said Bristol-Myers applied to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market a new drug that reduces blood pressure. The company developed the drug, Irbesartan, with France's Sanofi SA, it added.
